hints.title: Adjacent Color State Constraint
hints.text: When painting the current house red, the previous house must be painted blue or green. Similar constraints apply to blue and green.

hints.title: Three-Variable Rolling Minimum Accumulation
hints.text: Maintain three running variables representing the minimum cost to paint up to the current house ending in red, blue, or green.

hints.title: Optimal Substructure Linear Recurrence
hints.text: Initialize costs for house zero. For each subsequent house, update red cost by adding the minimum of previous blue and green, blue cost by adding minimum of previous red and green, and green by adding minimum of previous red and blue. Return min(r, b, g).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching over 3 colors for N houses explores 3 * 2^(N-1) combinations, taking exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing only the three color costs of the previous house reduces auxiliary memory to O(1) while achieving linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize state compression from an N x 3 table down to three scalar variables.
